presetsPortrait.intro: Presets for photos of people: from natural light and gentle skin tones to high-contrast dramatic shots and a clean studio look. Pick a mood with the filter below and compare before/after on your own photo.

presetsNature.intro: Presets for landscapes and walks: warm golden-hour tones, deep forest greens, fresh turquoise sea and presets that bring dull overcast shots back to life.

presetsUrban.intro: Presets for street photography, architecture and city portraits: understated minimalism, a contrasty film-like street look and the popular cinematic teal-and-orange contrast.

presetsNight.intro: Night cities, neon signs, evening streets and low-light shots. These presets make lights glow, deepen the mood or carefully pull detail out of the dark.

presetsSummer.intro: Presets for vacations and summer walks: bright sunshine, turquoise water, warm evenings and juicy colors for travel photos you want to post right away.

presetsAuto.intro: Presets for automotive photography: a clean showroom gloss, a dark dramatic garage and warm sunset shots. For sale listings there is a separate collection with honest colors and no stylization.

presetsAutumn.intro: Presets for fall photos: golden and crimson leaves, cozy warm shots with coffee and sweaters, and moody rainy streets. The style filters help you find the right mood fast.

presetsWinter.intro: Presets for winter walks and the holidays: clean white snow without a blue cast, frosty cool tones, warm string lights and cozy shots by the Christmas tree.

presetsFilm.intro: A film look for digital photos: analog colors, 35mm grain, faded vintage, 70s, 80s and 90s retro, Lomo, Polaroid, sepia and noir. Pick a style with the filter and apply it to your shot.

presetsCinematic.h1Accent: make photos look like film stills
presetsCinematic.intro: Presets with movie-style color grading: teal and orange contrast, deep moody tones, warm film colors and black and white classics. For portraits, cityscapes and atmospheric shots.

presetsBrightenDark.h1: How to brighten a dark photo
presetsBrightenDark.intro: Did your photo come out dark, dull or muddy? These presets lift shadows and exposure while protecting the highlights from blowing out — the shot becomes brighter and cleaner without fiddling with curves.

why.brighten-shadows: Lifts shadows and overall brightness the most while holding back highlights — for backlit and indoor photos.
why.bright-clear: Brightens the shot and adds clarity and punch without changing colors — a go-to for a merely dull photo.
why.low-light-rescue: For really dark evening shots: strong brightening plus muted blue color noise.
why.overcast-boost: For gray overcast shots: a bit of light, warmth and saturation so the photo doesn't look dirty.
why.clean-minimal: Gently brightens and tones colors down — for a light, airy look.

presetsProductPhoto.intro: Presets for product photos in listings and online stores: more light, cleaner whites without a yellow cast, crisper details and true colors. Shoppers click more often on bright, tidy photos.

why.clean-white-product: Brightens whites and light areas the most and removes the yellow cast of indoor lamps — the background gets closer to white.
why.bright-clear: Brightens and makes details crisper without changing color — for products where exact color matters.
why.lifestyle-product: Soft warm light for products shown in an interior: decor, textiles, cosmetics, handmade goods.
why.studio-clean: A neutral studio look: a little more contrast, clean whites and restrained colors.

presetsCarSale.h1: Car photos for a sale listing:
presetsCarSale.intro: Presets for photos of a car you're selling online or on social media: more light, crisp reflections on the body and visible interior details — without stylization that changes the car's color and puts buyers off.

why.bright-automobile: Boosts contrast and body reflections, lifts shadows in the interior and wheel arches, and keeps the real color.
why.showroom-gloss: A clean showroom look: bright highlights, deeper blacks and slightly richer colors.
why.overcast-boost: Saves photos taken on a cloudy day: the car and the background stop looking gray.
why.bright-clear: Simply brightens and clarifies — for shots of the interior, dashboard and details.

presetsFood.intro: Mouth-watering dish photos for a café menu, a delivery page or your own blog: warm tasty tones, fresh bright greens or a dark restaurant style. Match the mood to the venue or the dish.

why.food-warm-appetizing: Warmer, richer reds and oranges — for pastries, meat, pizza and soups.
why.fresh-bright-food: A bright shot with juicy greens — for salads, breakfasts, bowls and desserts.
why.moody-food: A dark restaurant style with deep shadows and focus on the dish.
why.bright-clear: Just brighter and crisper without color changes — when a food photo came out dull.

presetsAvatar.intro: Presets for profile photos in messengers, LinkedIn, résumés or social media: even light, natural skin tone and a clean background. People should recognize you from your avatar, so only subtle presets are here.

why.natural-skin: Minimal intervention: a bit of light and warmth and a more even skin tone — you look like yourself, just better lit.
why.studio-clean: A neutral business look for LinkedIn and résumés: clean whites and moderate contrast.
why.clean-minimal: Light and soft — great for photos by a window or against a light background.
why.soft-pastel: Gentle pastel tones for personal pages and creative profiles.
why.timeless-bw: A classic black and white portrait — understated and stylish, and it hides a bad color balance.

presetsWedding.intro: Presets for wedding and engagement photos: a bright airy style, gentle pastels, warm film, golden hour and timeless black and white. They also work well for christenings, graduations and other special occasions.

why.wedding-bright-airy: The most popular wedding style: lots of light, soft shadows and clean whites on the dress.
why.soft-pastel: Delicate pastel colors and a light haze — for romantic shots.
why.analog-warm-400: A warm film look with grain — for atmospheric documentary-style photos.
why.golden-hour: Enhances warm evening light — for the couple's sunset walk.
why.timeless-bw: A soft black and white that never dates — for first kisses, hugs and guests' emotions.
why.blush-moody: A warmer, deeper mood with pinkish accents — for evening shots and interiors.
